            return 1
        else:

a(2k+1) - a(2k-1) = (2k+2)(2k+3) - (2k)(2k+1)
$$

$$
= (4k^2 + 10k + 6) - (4k^2 + 2k) = 8k + 6
$$

So, for odd $ n $, we have:

$$
a(n) = a(n-2) + 4n + 2
$$

### Step 3: Final Recurrence

Combining both cases, the recurrence relation is:

$$
a(n) = 
\begin{cases}
a(n-2) + 2n + 1, & \text{if } n \text{ is even} \\
a(n-2) + 4n + 2, & \text{if } n \text{ is odd}
\end{cases}
$$

with initial conditions:

$$
a(0) = 1, \quad a(1) = 6
$$
